requirement_text:
Organisation: CBRE — Advisory & Transaction Services (India)
Segment: Commercial Real Estate — Office Leasing Advisory

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Python, React, Azure, CoStar API, SharePoint API
DATA SOURCES: Existing CBRE Lease Portal building inventory, CoStar market data API for market rents, CBRE internal fit-out cost model (to be converted to API), SharePoint landlord concession database (to be structured)
COMPARISON DIMENSIONS: Rent per sq ft, Landlord concessions, Lease terms, Fit-out costs
LIVE ADJUSTABLE VARIABLES: Lease term, Escalation percentage, TI allowance, Fit-out specification level (basic/mid/premium)
OUTPUT FORMAT: Shareable PDF document export
REAL TIME RECALCULATION: Yes, calculations update in real time during presentations
AUDIT TRAIL: Yes, all changes and states are attributable to a specific broker for audit purposes
DEVICE SUPPORT: Tablet (iPad) for client meetings, Desktop for preparation and review
EXPECTED OUTCOME: Reduction of preparation time to under 30 minutes, capability for live reconfiguration during client meetings, and uniform presentation format across all CBRE India brokers within 90 days post-launch
REGULATORY

acceptance_criteria.then: Validate & sanitise all inputs against the declared schema.
Log every decision/response immutably for audit.
Produce cluster/anomaly assignments with a quality score.
Persist the fitted model + assignment for each input row.

business_rules.statement: Validate & sanitise all inputs against the declared schema.
